title: Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014 — official amendment-history note in 2020 Gazette notification

content.publisher: Ministry of Corporate Affairs / Gazette of India, hosted by India Code
content.citation: Companies (Management and Administration) Amendment Rules, 2020, Gazette notification dated 28 August 2020, amendment-history note to G.S.R. 260(E)
content.note: The official 2020 Gazette notification's amendment-history note lists the principal Rules (G.S.R. 260(E), 31 March 2014) and subsequent notifications through G.S.R. 560(E), 13 June 2018, including G.S.R. 175(E), 16 February 2018. The 2020 notification's operative amendment concerns rule 12, not rule 18. This record is evidence of the notification list printed in that 2020 instrument only; it does not establish the complete amendment history after 28 August 2020 or prove by itself that no later amendment affects rule 18.
